Definition: probably of foreign origin; a sabre, i.e. a long and broad cutlass (any weapon of the kind, literally or figuratively):--sword.
BiblicalUsage: A sword shall pierce through thy own soul also, said Simeon to Mary, and out of the mouth of the risen Lord goes a sharp two-edged sword, the sword with which He shall smite the nations.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the sword from His mouth is sharper than any sword in a soldier's hand, because it cuts where no steel can reach.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Mary, Mother of Jesus; John the Apostle
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
